title: Bain Capital Griffin Aircraft Fund

toc.text: The Middle East conflict triggered an acute fuel cost shock, reinforcing airline demand for asset-light leasing structures.
Despite healthier Boeing delivery performance and Airbus factory outperformance, deliveries continue to lag. As such, leasing continues to be an attractive solution
Over the course of the quarter, we added 20x assets to the Aircraft Fund portfolio across 2x transactions – both high impact opportunities.
Our existing portfolio is comprised of 33x aircraft1 and 5x engines2, built across five high-impact transactions.
